summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature (not run; verification by reading only). Changes: rich/progress.py adds private _ProgressReader (RawIOBase + BinaryIO) and _reader_context, module-level open/wrap_file with _make_file_progress helper, and Progress.open/Progress.wrap_file methods with typed overloads. tests/test_progress.py gains 19 tests before the script-entry block. docs/source/progress.rst gains "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" subsections. CHANGELOG.md gains one Unreleased/Added bullet linking PR 1759. Choices: module-level open annotates mode as Any to avoid overload mismatch; no return-value/type-var suppressions added; columns follow spec list (no percentage column); zero-byte advances skipped. Not verified: pytest, mypy, black, and Python 3.6 compatibility of the multiple-inheritance reader were not run. Nothing committed.
